title: Metadata tree: discover how your service desk is built
goal: Inspect your training configuration, trace a reference type and prepare a separate verified copy before changes.

prerequisites.text: 1c-enterprise.a 3; A1–A2: separate infobase, catalogs, references and documents; synthetic data only.

sections.title: From a familiar situation to a checkable question
paragraphs: A request card displays a customer’s name. Does the field store that caption or a link to a particular card? Open your service tree and follow the field to its reference type. Read the definition first; no structural change is needed just to locate it.

sections.title: Where to act
paragraphs: Continue your service in a separate verified copy from the preceding lesson. Preserve the original and completedDT. The example adds a customer note; the independent task uses another document field in a further copy. Before changing anything verify the target and field list. Nexus stores the lesson and your note, but does not operate the external1Capplication.

sections.title: Two windows expose different aspects
paragraphs: Enterprise contains your actual customers and requests. Designer describes which object kinds and fields exist and the types permitted in them. Клиенты in the tree describes a catalog; it is not the individual Учебный Север item. One description supports many items.

Close Enterprise for your base and select Конфигуратор in the launcher. If the tree is hidden choose Конфигурация → Открыть конфигурацию. An empty work area before opening the tree does not establish missing development. The first inspection adds or updates nothing.

sections.title: Reason before acting
paragraphs: The tree describes the relationship; the form holds its selected value.
Identify the infobase, list and particular record separately. A command, visible text and saved state are different things.

sections.title: Five objects in one training story
paragraphs: Under Справочники locate Клиенты and Услуги, the persistent participants. Under Документы locate ЗаявкаУслуги, a dated and numbered request. Перечисления → СтатусыЗаявки defines prepared status values. Отчеты → ЗаявкиПоКлиентам presents already saved facts. The УчебнаяСлужба subsystem gathers commands into a section.

An empty Регистры накопления category does not prove this package implements accumulation accounting. General platform categories remain available in a small configuration. Do not claim movements, posting or accounting merely because the category exists; inspect concrete objects and behavior.

sections.title: Predict the result
paragraphs: A service name resembles a customer name. Can you change Услуга to a string and consider its relation preserved?

reveal.title: Check the reasoning
paragraphs: No. Услуга references an item in its own catalog. Text with the same caption is not that reference. Check the object and type in the tree, and the saved record separately in the application.

sections.title: An attribute holds a typed value
paragraphs: Expand Документы → ЗаявкаУслуги → Реквизиты and inspect Клиент. Its type is СправочникСсылка.Клиенты, which explains selecting an existing catalog item instead of storing similar name text. Renaming that item retains the relationship until another customer is selected.

Compare Услуга, ДлительностьМинут and Статус: another catalog reference, a number and an enumeration value serve different purposes. A numeric type alone does not specify units; minutes are established separately by the model and validation. Technical names serve code and synonyms serve the user interface; avoid accidental edits while inspecting.

sections.title: Check the explanation’s boundary
paragraphs: If the original is selected as the restore target, cancel instead of replacing it.
Separate the catalog description from its many Enterprise items.

sections.title: Begin changes with a verified copy
paragraphs: Before the first structural change export your continuing work through Администрирование → Выгрузить информационную базу…. Save a .dt in a separate clearly named folder and wait for success. It contains configuration and data; .cf does not replace a request-data backup.

Create a new infobase without configuration in the launcher, with a distinct name and new folder. In its Designer use Администрирование → Загрузить информационную базу… with your .dt. Restoration replaces its target, so use only the new empty base. Retain the original and export; do not copy a running 1Cv8.1CD in Explorer as a substitute.

sections.title: Restore proves the backup
paragraphs: Open the new copy in Enterprise. Compare customer codes, request numbers, durations and comments, then generate the familiar report. The sequential four-request dataset gives 4/120; use your independent expectation for additional work. Continue later lessons in this copy only after reconciliation.

Keep a short record: original name, copy name, export date, platform version, control numbers and total. Nexus retains your lesson and self-report but cannot observe the external base or automatically certify restoration. Studio and source transfer are unnecessary for this inspection.

sections.title: A new independent task
paragraphs: In your separate verified copy find ЗаявкаУслуги → Attributes → Услуга. Without editing properties, record the complete type and locate the corresponding catalog in the tree. In the application find an earlier own request by number and identify its selected service. Explain the difference between the field type and the particular card; preserve the original infobase.
Record a prediction first. After your own attempt reveal the reference and compare the selected record as well as its number.

sections.title: Actual training-service window
paragraphs: The author created two new training copies by actualDTrestore. One applies customer note 80; the other adds request channel 40. Saving, restarting and comparing all eight old fields, identities and report 4/120 were performed. Two GUI captures show only saved values. Complete manual attribute creation, 80/81 and 40/41 boundaries, all learner steps, permissions and installer are NOT RUN.
